candidates.explanation: The change-email mail builds its link as frontendDomain + '/confirm-email', the same page used by the sign-up mail (userSignUp). That page calls POST auth/email/confirm (AuthService.confirmEmail), which only accepts inactive users and doesn't apply newEmail. The email-change flow needs the page that calls auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), for example '/confirm-new-email'. So following the link never completes the change.

fix.description: Change the URL path in MailService.confirmNewEmail from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'. The frontend page at that path should call POST /auth/email/confirm/new.
